description: This file defines a mapping profile for AutoMapper within the Profiles feature of the Conduit application. It specifies how to map between the Domain.Person class and the Profile class, with no member list validation.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A class inheriting from AutoMapper.Profile that sets up object-object mapping configurations.

methods.name: MappingProfile (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the mapping profile by defining a map between Domain.Person and Profile with no member list validation.
